source: English voice (US PlayStation release), transcribed by whisper.cpp large-v3

lines.text: Give an old man a break, will you? I think I pulled something.
You might not realize it, but someday you'll be old too.
Enjoy your youth while you can,
but develop your skills, because your speed won't last forever.
Oh, what do you care? You're not even listening anyway, are you? Later!
